findings.F-T518-2: Stair 1:3 bed: FINISH V1 applies the Q-45 B 5 % (Q-45 named the marble stair bed); STAIR_BED_V1 (Q-53 C / UP-STAIR-017) holds waste and uses the purchasing allowance. findings.F-T518-3: Cement whole bags are printed at sub-group scopes (T-500 per item code and per table; T-511 per trade); the purchasing group of 50 kg cement is the villa (all trades). A sum of sub-group ceilings is never a purchase (R-T518-2).
